topics.description: Recent arrests and charges related to Medicaid fraud in Minnesota have brought attention to the issue. Two individuals were arrested for a $21 million scheme, and 15 people were charged in a $90 million scheme.
topics.reason: New developments in Minnesota Medicaid fraud cases

topics.description: Federal agencies are actively investigating various cases, including a $90 million fraud scheme in Minnesota and a bribery scheme in Bexar County.
